title: The Flood Story Before the Bible
description:
He sorted broken clay at the British Museum in the evenings. He had been apprenticed at fourteen to engrave banknotes. In eighteen seventy-two he read a tablet nobody had translated. A man is warned that water is coming. He builds a boat. He sends out a dove, and it comes back: there is nowhere to land. On the third of December, George Smith read it to a room containing the prime minister.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Cold open
00:50 The story before the book
06:37 The sea that came in
12:34 Three hundred cubits
15:30 Everybody keeps finding it
19:31 Outro

SOURCES
An abrupt drowning of the Black Sea shelf — Ryan et al., Marine Geology 138 (1997)
https://doi.org/10.1016/S0025-3227(97)00007-8
Was the Black Sea catastrophically flooded in the early Holocene? — Giosan, Filip & Constantinescu, QSR 28 (2009)
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quascirev.2008.10.012
Is the abrupt drowning of the Black Sea shelf at 7150 yr BP a myth? — Görür et al., Marine Geology 176 (2001)
https://doi.org/10.1016/S0025-3227(01)00148-7
Bogus 'Noah's Ark' from Turkey Exposed as a Common Geologic Structure — Collins & Fasold, JGE 44(4) (1996)
https://www.csun.edu/~vcgeo005/Nr1Bogus2.pdf

Every credit — creator, licence and source URL — is in the pinned comment, because the full list is longer than a YouTube description may be.

Narration is synthesised speech. Graphics are original.

New video every Monday.
